definition: to lie on top of something and cover it
description: A sunny alpine valley. A marmot stands upright on a big lichen-covered rock in a meadow full of small purple, yellow and white wildflowers, then jumps down and runs off. A clear stream runs past a wooden fence and a small stone hut, dark pine woods cover the slopes, and a waterfall appears on the mountainside. Behind them rises a sharp, pointed mountain peak whose top is covered in white snow, with a plume of cloud blowing off the summit into the deep blue sky.
